title: alisma gramineum var. geyeri
intro: Alisma gramineum var. geyeri, commonly known as American water plantain, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Alismataceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of American water plantain include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support kidney function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
